title: BB Width Squeeze — Volatility Expansion Breakout on BTC 1h
objective: Test BB Width squeeze strategy (volatility contraction → bandwidth expansion breakout with momentum confirmation) on maximum realistic BTCUSDT 1h history (~43,789 bars, ~5 years) via full WFA engine with Optuna optimization (100 trials). Hypothesis: periods of BB Width contraction precede explosive directional moves; momentum filter + ATR stops provide positive expectancy. This is a volatility expansion signal, distinct from all prior mean-reversion (RSI, BB) or trend (EMA, SMA) strategies.
hypothesis: BB Width squeeze fires when volatility compresses to historical lows. When bandwidth subsequently expands, directional momentum tends to follow. BTC's 24/7 market avoids FX session-gap noise. With 43,789 bars (~5yr), WFA can run 55+ windows (3mo train / 1mo test) for statistical significance. Expected outcome: aggregate OOS Sharpe 0.5-1.0 if squeeze signals capture genuine vol-regime transitions.
strategy_rationale: No strategy in the factory has ever used BB Width or squeeze-breakout mechanics. All prior successful strategies (RSI 0.94, SMA 0.53, BB 0.39, EMA 0.528) use price-at-extremes or EMA-crossover signals. BB Width squeeze is a fundamentally different signal class: it detects vol contractions and anticipates vol expansion breakouts, which are common in BTC (sharp pumps/dumps follow quiet consolidations). Research from Bollinger, Keltner, and PyQuantLab confirms this pattern. Prior squeeze-adjacent strategies (ATR Breakout, London Sweep) failed due to wrong asset (BTC vs FX sessions) or wrong signal type (session-range vs volatility-width). BB Width squeeze directly targets BTC vol dynamics.
dataset_requirements: BTCUSDT 1h, Binance, full history ~2017 to 2026 (43,789 bars minimum)

historical_depth_requirement.target: Maximum realistic: Binance launched BTCUSDT in 2017. Current deep CSV has 43,789 bars (~5 years). This depth enables 55+ WFA windows for robust OOS statistics.
historical_depth_requirement.justification: 5yr BTC 1h is the maximum realistic depth available. Sufficient for 3mo train / 1mo test / 1mo step WFA (55+ windows). Longer history captures multiple market regimes (bull, bear, sideways). No structural reason to truncate.

data_acquisition.reason: binance_btcusdt_1h_deep.csv already present with 43,789 bars. No download needed.

inputs: walk forward engine/config/main_config.yaml (BB_WIDTH_SQUEEZE profile and definition already registered)
implementation_steps: 1. Verify all inputs exist and are valid (py_compile for .py, json/yaml load for configs)
3. Run full WFA via smoke_test runner: .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/bb_width_squeeze/wfa_config.yaml
4. Monitor for squeeze_break signal frequency: flag if total trades across all folds < 20 (trade-starved)
5. Collect aggregate OOS Sharpe, WFR, max DD, trade count, per-window Sharpe distribution
6. If trade-starved: record as partial, note squeeze_pct range needs expansion
7. If Sharpe >= 0.8 and trades >= 30: mark as passed

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: At least 20 trades across all WFA windows to avoid the trade-starved failure mode that killed ATR Breakout (2 trades) and London Sweep (2 trades).

fallback_if_blocked: If < 20 total trades across all folds: re-run with squeeze_pct expanded to [5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30] and width_period pinned to 10 (more frequent squeeze detection)
If WFA engine crashes on pandas dependency: verify .venv has pandas installed, check import paths
If data file missing or corrupt: re-download via workspace/data/fetchers/binance_deep_fetcher.py
notes: Key risk: squeeze signals are rarer than RSI — squeeze_pct=20 means only fire when BB Width is below its 20th percentile of last 20 bars. With 43,789 bars, this should still produce sufficient signals, but watch for trade-starved windows.
BB Width Squeeze uses bb_width_squeeze.py with LightweightBBWidthSqueeze class — confirmed in main_config.yaml lines 321-324.
min_required_bars=500 in wfa_config.yaml is correctly set (not 2000 like the bug in EMA Trend Gate).
WFA engine does not output IS Sharpe → WFR unavailable. Evaluate by aggregate OOS Sharpe alone.
8 parameters to optimize across 100 trials (3mo train windows): acceptable but not ideal. Stability_weight=0.15 penalizes parameter sensitivity to reduce overfitting risk.
